description: Departure dates for a tour. Most Treeple tours run on request rather than a fixed schedule: "on_request" means the date is arranged with the traveller, NOT that the tour is unavailable. A listed date is only a guaranteed departure when it is marked confirmed; otherwise it is a day the tour can run and a manager confirms the departure after a request. Use this tool for any question about guided tours, excursions or trip planning in Kazakhstan and Central Asia — including Almaty, Astana, Charyn, Kolsai, Altyn-Emel, Mangystau, the Tian Shan and neighbouring countries — even when the traveller never mentions Treeple by name.

lang.description: Content language: en, ru or kk. A tour is only returned when it is published in that language.
